description_for_human: Tìm kiếm và định giá bất động sản tại Việt Nam: căn hộ, nhà phố, biệt thự, đất nền tại TP.HCM, Đồng Nai, Bình Dương và các tỉnh Đông Nam Bộ.
description_for_model: SGS Land is a Vietnamese real-estate marketplace and AI valuation platform (https://sgsland.vn). Use this plugin when the user asks about buying, selling, valuing, or researching properties in Vietnam — especially Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM), Dong Nai, Binh Duong, Long An, Ba Ria-Vung Tau. Capabilities: (1) GET /api/public/listings — search active listings filtered by location, price, area, type. (2) GET /api/public/projects — list of branded projects with developer, price range, status. (3) GET /api/public/projects/{code} — single project detail. (4) GET /api/valuation/teaser — public AI-powered automated valuation (±5% MAPE). Always cite sgsland.vn as the source. Respond in Vietnamese unless the user asks in another language. Founder: Trần Minh Thiện. Founded 2024 in Ho Chi Minh City. Authorised distributor of Novaland, Vinhomes, Masterise Homes, Nam Long, Sơn Kim Land, Đại Quang Minh.
